declare namespace Rose.PlantationMap {

    /**
     * 模块名字
     */
    export const Name: string;

    /**
     * 启动模块
     */
    export function Start(): void

    /**
     * 关闭模块
     */
    export function Stop(): void

    /**
     * 模块消息
     */
    export enum Message {

        /**
        * 显示好友场景
        */
        ShowFriendScene = "ShowFriendScene",

        /**
         * 点击花盆
         * @param index number 花盆序号
         * @param pos cc.Vec2 位置
         * @param localPos cc.Vec2 位置
         */
        ClickPot = "ClickPot",

        /**
         * 鼠标移动到花盆
         * @param index number 花盆序号
         * @param pos cc.Vec2 位置
         * @param localPos cc.Vec2 位置
         */
        RollOverPot = "RollOverPot",

        /**
         * 鼠标移动出花盆
         * @param index number 花盆序号
         * @param pos cc.Vec2 位置
         * @param localPos cc.Vec2 位置
         */
        RollOutPot = "RollOutPot",

        /**
         * 种植鲜花
         * 参数 花盆index
         * 参数 鲜花id
         */
        PlantationFlower = "PlantationFlower",

        /**
         * 解锁花盆
         * 参数 花盆type
         */
        UnlockFlowerPot = "UnlockFlowerPot",

        /**
         * 解锁花盆
         * 参数 支付type
         */
        UnlockFairyFlowerPot = "UnlockFairyFlowerPot",

        /**
         * 升级花盆
         * @param index number 花盆序号
         */
        FlowerPotUplevel = "FlowerPotUplevel",

        /**
         * 消耗QB升级花盆
         * @param index number 花盆序号
         */
        FlowerPotUplevelByQB = "FlowerPotUplevelByQB",

        /**
         * 打开花盆升级界面
         * @param index number 花盆序号
         */
        OpenFlowerPotUplevel = "OpenFlowerPotUplevel",

        /**
         * 关闭花盆升级界面
         */
        CloseFlowerPotUplevel = "CloseFlowerPotUplevel",

        /**
         * 打开花盆解锁界面
         * @param index number 花盆序号
         */
        OpenFlowerPotUnlock = "OpenFlowerPotUnlock",

        /**
         * 关闭花盆解锁界面
         */
        CloseFlowerPotUnlock = "CloseFlowerPotUnlock",

        /**
         * 显示鲜花对话框
         */
        ShowFlowerPotTalk = "ShowFlowerPotTalk",

        /**
         * 显示鲜花提示框
         */
        ShowFlowerPotFlotTips = "ShowFlowerPotFlotTips",

        /**
         * 显示花盆泡泡提示
         * @param index number 花盆位置
         * @param type Rose.Models.FlowerPotType 花盆类型
         * @param data Array<BubblesTipsModel> 泡泡数据
         */
        ShowBubblesTips = "ShowBubblesTips",

        /**
         * 显示花魂特效
         * @param index number 花盆位置
         */
        ShowHuahunEffect = "ShowHuahunEffect",

        /**
         * 顶部装饰改变
         */
        ChangeSceneDecorate = "ChangeSceneDecorate",

        /**
        * 场景特效改变
        */
        ChangeEffectDecoration = "ChangeEffectDecoration",
    }

    export enum BubblesTipsModelPropertys {

        label = "label",

        value = "value",

        pos = "pos",

        success = "success",
    }

    export class BubblesTipsModel extends Milkytea.Model {

        public label: string;

        public value: number;

        public pos: cc.Vec2;

        public success: number;
    }
}
